title: Umineko When They Cry Episode 4: Alliance of the Golden Witch
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Twelve years after her family was murdered at their annual island gathering in October 1986, eighteen-year-old Ange Ushiromiya, the sole heir, is isolated at school and turns to her late cousin Maria's diary, with its talk of magic. In a meta-game against the witch Beatrice, Battler gains Ange as an ally while the murders replay with differences, and the story probes whether magic or a human explanation lies behind them.
life_message: Hope, love and the stories we believe in can carry people through despair, but the truth still matters.
